notes.title: HFTGames Fall Update
notes.notes:
We thought we would let everyone know what we are currently working on, and what we will be releasing in the very near future.

First, we are excited to announce that in coming weeks, we will release a FREE DLC scene for WanderLust. This will be an additional scene that takes place after the end of the game, where Elise and her two friends Eligara and Coralia all go back to visit the Wizard in his Tower, and receive his special magical treatment.

Secondly, we will soon be releasing a new Erotic "Sandbox" Style game that we have been working on off-and-on for quite some time, called "Pleasure Party"

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33733604/492e6c2fba9c700fc976f9b789aed8a100ac6cd0.jpg

In Pleasure Party, Tiffany has created a "Pleasure Detection Device" for her college senior project, and needs to test it out by hosting "Pleasure Parties" all over town with LOTS of her friends.

The game will feature sandbox style "free play" where you choose from 10 female characters (all professionally voiced), 6 male characters, 9 locations all over town, and pair the characters up using any of 25 different "positions". 

You will need to pay close attention to the compatibility of the characters you pair up, in order to generate the most pleasure, and you can increase the amount of pleasure a couple is generating by "connecting" them with another couple.

If you are interested, you can check out a Very Naughty, VERY NSFW teaser gameplay video here: https://hftgames.com/content/PleasurePartyTeaser1.mp4.

And finally, we are still hard at work on development of our next Lilly Knight/WanderLust style Epic Erotic RPG, which is called "Penny Patty Piper in Space".

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33733604/2c2133b8839b30cced7c5239a02ea612a17961ed.jpg

In addition to all of this, we continue to work on refining a game design for "Mandy's Room 3", and a number of other fun projects that are just in the early design stage at this time.

We can't wait to get these new games and add-ons out to you and see what you think.

Stay tuned, and thanks again for everyone's support!

notes.title: Mandy's Room update for Mid-November
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We just wanted to give a quick update and let you know that the "Mandy's Dream" DLC is about 80% complete. We expect to be able to release this DLC on or around December 1st, so stay tuned and thanks for being patient with us. I know a lot of you are as excited about it as we are!

Also, we will be adding more controller functionality to the main game. Nothing too exciting, just the ability to pause, access the menu and recenter the camera using the VR controllers, as well as the ability to say "Yes" and "No" to Mandy with controller buttons, in case you don't want to shake your head.

It's funny, we built Mandy's Room to be "Hands Free", where you shake and nod your head and don't need to have controllers in your hands at all to play, but the number one complaint we receive is "How come I can't do stuff with my controller?". So we're taking your advice and feedback and adding more controller support.

Additionally, the "Mandy's Dream" DLC will include full controller support, including virtual hands that you can use to interact with Mandy during the three fantasy scenes.

That's all for now. Thanks again for your amazing support of Mandy's Room!

notes.title: Mandy's Room Version 1.07 Released!
notes.notes:
We just released a small update to Mandy's Room. Here is what's included:

A new SCENES feature, where you can revisit six of the key scenes within the game, after completion. Once your game is updated, the new button should already be there and available to you if you have finished the game.A cute Halloween themed Main Menu.More enhancements to the menu navigation using VR controllers, including the Oculus Remote.Other minor bug fixes.

Make sure your copy of Mandy's Room is updated, and Have Fun!

notes.title: Mandy's Room Update V1.06
notes.notes:
We have updated Mandy's Room this morning to version 1.06. This update includes:


Visual enhancement when running without VR, including improved Anti-Aliasing and Ambient Occlusion.
Improved controls on the Main Menu with various controllers (as requested in feedback).
Improved contrast on Main Menu buttons (as requested).
In VR, from any screen, press "R" to reset the camera view (as requested).


Thanks again to all of our supporters, and a special thanks to those who are taking the time to leave positive reviews!
